description: Start a Stripe Checkout credit top-up. Same as POST /v1/wallets/:id/checkout. Returns the checkout url (open that URL; it keeps Stripe's hosted-page fragment). credits is an integer from 500 to 100000 ($5 minimum). Credits are applied only after Stripe reports the session paid. Returns the API error when Stripe is not configured.

api_key.description: Wallet API key (bsk_…). Optional when the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer. The local stdio process also reads BOTSUPPLY_API_KEY.

credits.description: Credits to buy. 1 credit = $0.01 USD. Minimum 500 credits ($5). Same limits as POST /v1/wallets/:id/checkout.

wallet_id.description: Wallet to credit. Defaults to the wallet that owns the API key.

name: create_checkout
title: Create checkout
